{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Texas cuisine|Texas cuisine]]
==Ingredients==
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (360 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Tortilla Chip|tortilla chips]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (450 g) [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]], grated 
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (80 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] canned peeled green [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]] (optional)
* ½ cup (about 120 ml) chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400°F (200°C). Lay the tortilla chips on a [[Cookbook:Cookie Sheet|cookie sheet]]. 
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] together the cheese, chilies and onion; sprinkle over the tortilla chips. 
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 2 minutes, or until the cheese has melted.
#Serve hot.
